tasks.label: 0 - Diagnostico: verificar Python y Node
tasks.command: Write-Host '--- Python ---'; python --version; Write-Host '--- Node ---'; node --version; npm --version; Write-Host '--- Entorno virtual ---'; if (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe') { Write-Host 'OK: el entorno virtual existe' } else { Write-Host 'FALTA: ejecuta la tarea 1' }; Write-Host '--- Dependencias del frontend ---'; if (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/frontend/node_modules') { Write-Host 'OK: node_modules existe' } else { Write-Host 'FALTA: ejecuta la tarea 4' }

tasks.label: 1 - Backend: crear entorno e instalar dependencias
tasks.command: python -m venv .venv; & '${workspaceFolder}/backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe' -m pip install --upgrade pip; & '${workspaceFolder}/backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe' -m pip install -r requirements.txt
